open_questions.topic: 0.5 special-case interaction with divergence flag boundary
open_questions.summary: ADR-0022 §raw_mapping authors the attestation 0.5 special case (no_pii_processing_attest + substrate>=3.0) as the low-PII corroborated bucket. ADR-0022 §composition rule authors the divergence boundary as (substrate>=3.0 AND attestation<=1.0). The two interact: M3's substrate=4.0/attestation=0.5 fires divergence per the spec text, but the semantic intent of the 0.5 special case is corroboration, not divergence.
